settings.question_2: Is It Safe With My Medications?

Yes, Peak Form is designed to work WITH your thyroid medication, not replace it. Our formula enhances your body's ability to convert and use the thyroid hormone from your prescription. Many customers taking Synthroid, Levothyroxine, or NDT report better results from their existing medication.

settings.answer_3:
Complete Ingredient List & Why Each Matters:

Selenium (200mcg)
Essential for T4 to T3 conversion. Your body needs selenium to build deiodinase enzymes that activate thyroid hormone. Most people with thyroid issues are severely deficient.

Iodine (100mcg)

The building block of thyroid hormones. Our precise 2:1 selenium-to-iodine ratio ensures optimal hormone production without triggering autoimmune flare-ups.

Zinc (15mg)
Critical for thyroid receptor function. Even with adequate hormone levels, zinc deficiency prevents your cells from actually using the thyroid hormone available.

L-Tyrosine (500mg)
The amino acid precursor your thyroid uses to manufacture hormones. Supports mental clarity and helps combat brain fog.

Ashwagandha (300mg)
Adaptogenic herb that helps regulate stress hormones (cortisol) which can block thyroid function. Reduces inflammation and protects thyroid tissue.

Vitamin B12 (Methylcobalamin - 100mcg)
Active form for better absorption. Supports energy production and helps reverse the fatigue associated with poor thyroid function.

Magnesium (50mg)
Required for over 300 enzymatic reactions including thyroid hormone production and T4 to T3 conversion.

Copper (1mg)
Works synergistically with zinc for optimal thyroid receptor sensitivity. Proper copper-zinc balance is crucial.

Manganese (2mg)
Supports thyroid hormone synthesis and protects against oxidative stress that damages thyroid tissue.

Vitamin D3 (1000 IU)
Modulates immune function and reduces thyroid antibodies in autoimmune conditions like Hashimoto's.

settings.question: Can I take Peak Form with my thyroid medication?
settings.answer:
Yes, Peak Form is designed to work alongside Synthroid, Levothyroxine, or NDT - not replace it. Our formula enhances your body's ability to convert and use thyroid hormone from your prescription. Many customers report better results from their existing medication and some have reduced their dosage with doctor approval.

settings.question: Is it safe for Hashimoto's or other autoimmune conditions?
settings.answer: Yes. Our formula uses carefully balanced iodine levels (100mcg) that support thyroid function without triggering autoimmune flare-ups. The selenium and vitamin D actually help reduce thyroid antibodies. However, if you have hyperthyroidism or Graves' disease, consult your doctor before use.

settings.question: Why liquid instead of pills?

settings.question: What if I've tried other thyroid supplements that didn't work?
settings.answer: We understand - most of our customers tried 5-10 supplements before Peak Form. The difference is our precise 2:1 selenium-to-iodine ratio that forces T4→T3 conversion, plus liquid delivery that actually absorbs. That's why we offer a 60-day money-back guarantee - you risk nothing trying it.

settings.question: How do I take it?
settings.answer: Take one dropper (1ml) daily, preferably in the morning. You can take it directly under your tongue for fastest absorption, or mix it with water or juice. Take with or without food. If you're on thyroid medication, you can take Peak Form at the same time or separately - both work fine.
